summary: Hanshow is reimagine Intelligent Retail, founded in 2012. Type: startup / scale-up. About 436 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: A Chinese maker of electronic shelf labels and digital store tech with a Dutch branch in Amsterdam that sponsors visas.

culture.text: Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Jiaxing, China, with overseas branches including France, Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and the US.
Staff often studied computer science or international business, at schools like University of Amsterdam, Shanghai Jiao Tong and Duisburg-Essen.

open.text: Hanshow Netherlands B.V. is an IND recognised sponsor.
Both current entry-level roles in Amsterdam are open to non-Dutch speakers, and one mentions visas.

growth.text: It says it works with over half of the top 100 global retailers, with solutions in over 55,000 stores in 70+ countries.
Hanshow and Microsoft expanded their partnership on AI-powered retail.

worth_knowing.text: Its LinkedIn postings get about 85 applicants on average.
